newsitem.title: USA: E-Z-EM recalls personal protective shields.
newsitem.headline: E-Z-EM recalls personal protective shields.

text.p: E-Z-EM Inc said on Friday that it is voluntarily recalling some of its lead- containing personal shields that are used by x-ray technicians.
The products have been shown to contain small amounts of radiation, which does not demonstrate a threat to health and safety, the company said.

E-Z-EM said a supplier of lead powder received lead with small amounts of radioactive contamination. The material was susequently made into the lead vinyl used in the personal protective shields, the company said.
E-Z-EM will remove these products from the market for replacement. The products affected were made after February 1, 1997, the company said.
